capabilities: Generate context-aware inline completions while typing
Chat with AI models in a sidebar chat view
Configure providers (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama) and models independently for completions and chat
Set monthly usage limits and monitor costs in a chart
Cache completions in memory and filter completions by filename or tag
extras: Advanced prompting techniques are marked Beta; the Ollama provider is marked Preview. The README warns that content is sent to OpenAI/OpenRouter APIs and that users are responsible for monitoring costs. Troubleshooting notes a Tab keybinding conflict with Obsidian Outliner.
intentEvidence: Markpilot is designed to be a GitHub Copilot-flavored alternative that provides both features in one plugin
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI completion or chat features, and existing plugins cover only one of the two, forcing users to install and manage separate tools.

relations.evidence: It aims to provide a similar experience to GitHub Copilot in Obsidian.
There are plugins that provide similar features, such as Obsidian Companion
I took inspirations from Obsidian Copilot Autocompletion to implement the few-shot prompts feature.

requires.name: OpenAI API key or OpenRouter API key

summary: AI plugin that provides context-aware inline completions and a sidebar chat view powered by OpenAI, OpenRouter, or local Ollama models.
